_comment: Products that exist only on the server, never in the app's bundled seed. Add with `npm run incoming:add` while the server is stopped, then start it: the app syncs them in (offline -> back online). Remove with `npm run incoming:remove`.

products.name: Lavender Sugar Donut
products.description: A soft ring rolled in lavender sugar with a half coat of violet sprinkles. Lightly floral, not too sweet.

products.name: Chocolate Trio Box
products.description: Three chocolate favourites in one box: s'mores with toasted marshmallow, a white-glazed chocolate drizzle, and a coffee glaze with raspberry crumbs.
